summary: Product requirements for support ticket normalization, deduplication, prioritization, and triage summary reporting based on support team interviews.

requirements.description: Handle ticket updates by keeping only the last occurrence of each ticket ID and excluding tickets whose latest state is closed.

sources.quote: Repeated IDs are updates: keep the last occurrence, and exclude tickets whose latest state is closed.

acceptance.given: a list of tickets that may contain repeated IDs and status updates
acceptance.then: only the last occurrence of each ID is evaluated, and tickets whose latest state is closed are excluded from the summary and queue

requirements.description: Order open tickets in the triage queue by severity (urgent before normal before low), breaking ties with the ticket ID in ascending order.

sources.quote: Urgent open tickets must appear before normal and low tickets; ties should use the ticket ID in ascending order.

acceptance.given: a set of open tickets with different severities and IDs
acceptance.then: urgent tickets precede normal tickets, which precede low tickets, and ties within the same severity are ordered by ticket ID in ascending order

requirements.description: Summarize open tickets by counting tickets for each severity level and listing unique affected customer IDs in ascending order.

sources.quote: The summary must count open tickets by severity and list each affected customer once in ascending ID order.

acceptance.given: a set of open tickets across various customers and severity levels
acceptance.when: the triage summary metrics are calculated
acceptance.then: openCount reflects the total open tickets, bySeverity provides counts for urgent, normal, and low, and customerIds contains unique customer IDs sorted in ascending order

assumptions: Tickets with repeated IDs represent sequential updates where later occurrences supersede earlier ones.
Input objects are never mutated during normalization or summarization.
Non-array ticket collections or malformed tickets cause summarizeTickets to throw a TypeError.
Field values for id, title, and customerId must be nonempty strings after whitespace trimming.
Ticket severities must be one of urgent, normal, or low, case-insensitively.
Ticket states must be either open or closed, case-insensitively.
